ns2:section.sectionText: Full-time practice of engineering in an off-campus industrial or research laboratory environment. Work report, on-line Company Card Report, and on-line ABET report required. It is expected that students enrolling in this course for Fall or Spring semesters will work at least 12 weeks during the semester, and students enrolling for Summer will work at least 8 weeks during summer. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Completion of freshman year or consent of Director of Engineering Career Services.
